jobs.description: What we are looking forBecome part of Fairmas as a Junior Compliance Coordinator (all genders) and help us build a solid foundation for our information security management system. The role sits at the intersection of compliance, information security, process management, and documentation — coordinating requirements, structuring evidence, and making our processes audit-ready. able to document complex topics clearly, precisely, and in an audit-ready way.• Structure: Systematic, thorough, and reliable — you keep track of open points, deadlines, and responsibilities without being prompted.• Collaboration: Professional and clear communicator with management, IT, legal, HR, and data protection stakeholders.• Discretion: High sense of responsibility when handling sensitive information.• Tools: Experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Notion, Excel, or GRC tools is a benefit.• Regulatory knowledge: Basic knowledge of GDPR, IT law, data protection law, or contract review is a plus• Industry background: Experience in a software, SaaS, or IT-oriented company is an advantage.• Employment Eligibility: Must be legally authorized to in Germany.How you make an impact• ISMS Development: Support the setup, structuring, and maintenance of our ISO 27001-compliant information security management system — as a coordinating and documenting function in close exchange with management, IT, HR, legal, and data protection.• Requirements Analysis: Break down ISO 27001 controls, identify gaps, assign responsibilities, and track required evidence.• Documentation: Create, revise, and maintain policies, process descriptions, work instructions, checklists, and audit evidence documents.• Audit Preparation: Compile and organize audit materials; ensure all required evidence is in place and traceable.• Task Tracking: Maintain an up-to-date action and task plan including status, owners, deadlines, and open items.• Risk Management: Assist with gap analyses, risk assessments, and documenting risk treatment measures.• Cross-Team Coordination: Gather information and coordinate with IT, HR, legal, data protection, management, and relevant departments.• Process Documentation: Document security processes such as access management, change management, incident management, backup, vendor management, asset management, and awareness programs.• Follow-Through: Track and close open points from internal reviews, external consultations, audits, and management decisions.• Stakeholder Communication: Prepare clear decision bases and summaries for management and business units.Get in Touch! Ready to Join Us? Send us your CV – feel free to include your earliest possible start date. If you have any questions, reach out to us at hr@fairmas.com – we’re happy to help.You don’t meet every single requirement or have gaps in your resume? No problem!Apply anyway – what matters most to us are your motivation, values, and personality.About usFairmas GmbH and its affiliates is a hotel software company specializing in web-based solutions for financial planning, controlling, and management reporting. Since our founding in 2003 in Berlin, our dedicated team, including hoteliers, IT experts, and professionals from a variety of backgrounds, has been supporting more than 18,000 users across 5,500 hotels worldwide.We take pride in delivering first-class service built on years of experience. At Fairmas, we foster a company culture defined by transparency, mutual respect, and strong team spirit. For us, work-life balance isn’t just a buzzword — it’s essential to maintaining long-term motivation and creativity. We firmly believe that our employees are the driving force behind Fairmas, and their ideas and contributions actively shape our company’s future.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Customer Development Specialist (m/f/d) – Infectiology (Referent/in - Klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description: Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Remote, Leipzig, HalleWork ScheduleStandard (Mon-Fri)Environmental ConditionsOfficeJob DescriptionJob DescriptionAs part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.Location:Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central GermanyIdeally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or BerlinDiscover Impactful WorkJoin our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.A Day in the Life:You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.What to expect:- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).Keys to Success:Education- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.Experience- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.Knowledge, Skills, Abilities- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.Benefits:We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of  , color, religion, ___ ,   orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description: Company DescriptionWork with Us. Change the World.At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.Job DescriptionAECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.**Job Responsibilities:** - Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projectsQualifications- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)- DC Experience in accountable DM position- Proficient in contractual German and English- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines- Excellent communication skills are essentialAdditional InformationWhy join us?You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 40%
